budget_scope_and_stop: The USD 20 cap is shared with all project calls. All 12 markets' combined theoretical worst-case reservations exceed that cap. Each market must have headroom for its four remaining rounds before one supervised round is started. Actual settlement can release unused reservation, but later markets may remain PENDING_BUDGET; none is substituted or removed from ITT denominators.
execution_order_limitation: The fixed priority favors primary contrasts before turnover and crossover, with seeded order within R/priority blocks. This improves pilot coverage under the shared cap but time or provider drift may confound an incomplete arm comparison. Any later causal analysis must retain order and market blocks and report this limit.
market_execution_policy: Primary R1 arms, then primary R0, turnover, and crossover; within each priority block seeded order. One market at a time in this frozen order; each of its four rounds runs in round_index order, one supervised invocation per round. Never choose the next arm after viewing an outcome.
offer_policy: Each DIRECT market has one preassigned researcher-authored untrusted promise round and one fact-matched no-offer round. A delivered/read offer is a positive-control mediator; never count channel access alone as offer exposure.

stop_and_skip_policy.after_episode: Stop on UNKNOWN billing, model/native failure, source or assignment drift, hidden-truth leak, unauthorized role capability, or unverifiable archived evidence. Record the assigned market as FAILED or INCOMPLETE and keep all later scheduled markets PENDING. Do not substitute another arm.
stop_and_skip_policy.before_market: If the shared ledger cannot reserve all four remaining rounds at worst-case published rates, retain that market and later markets as PENDING_BUDGET; stop execution.
stop_and_skip_policy.inference: All 12 markets and 48 rounds stay in descriptive denominators. Report missing-outcome bounds; inferential contrasts require adequate market clusters and separate preregistration.
stop_and_skip_policy.nonadherence: A valid DIRECT model run with no successful worker post or auditor read remains COMPLETE in its assigned-arm ITT denominator; expose post, delivery and read separately.
